## Change and scope

Which public knowledge/source cards and exact versions changed? Preserve K/S-IDs on rename. Explain conditions and limitations.

## Evidence and review

List original source links and verified locators, evidence strength, replication status and lifecycle separately. Explain unresolved conflicts and the reason for any supersession proposal.

## Update impact

Include affected IDs from `query_update_impact` or CLI `impact`, necessary 1–2 hop dependencies, incoming/outgoing relation review, and citation repairs for changed/deleted sources or targets.

## Validation

- [ ] Standard library tests (including actual MCP subprocess) pass.
- [ ] Formal Markdown validates; text indexes rebuilt and reviewed.
- [ ] Only public intended content; no private data, credentials or restricted full papers.
- [ ] No SQLite/bytecode/cache files committed; no global configuration or unrelated project changes.
